correct_recommendations: Run the major upgrade on Sunday 8 November 2026 in the 02:00 to 05:00 UTC window, after the pg_partman 5.1 upgrade on 4 November and its two nightly runs on 5 and 6 November.
invalid_options: Sunday 1 November, Saturday 31 October or any slot inside the month-end freeze.
Sunday 15 November or any date after 12 November, because AR-7 requires the upgrade before PostgreSQL 14 end of life.
Any window before Saturday 7 November 02:00 UTC, because pg_partman 5.1 has not completed two nightly runs by then.
root_cause: Not applicable. The open item is the maintenance window. pg_partman 5.1 is booked for 4 November 10:00 UTC and must complete two nightly runs at 03:30 UTC, on 5 and 6 November. The upgrade must finish before 12 November. Sunday 02:00 to 05:00 UTC has the lowest write traffic, so Sunday 8 November is the only Sunday that fits.

dependent_facts.true_value: pg_partman goes to 5.1 on PostgreSQL 14 before the major upgrade
PostgreSQL 14 end of life 12 November 2026; AR-7 requires the upgrade before then
30 October 18:00 UTC to 4 November 09:00 UTC; no production database change, extension upgrades included
pg_partman 5.1 must complete two nightly runs at 03:30 UTC in production; step 1 is booked for 4 November 10:00 UTC, so the runs are on 5 and 6 November
about 14 minutes for pg_upgrade --link, then about 38 minutes of online analyze with slow reports
Sunday 02:00 to 05:00 UTC about 40 writes per second, Saturday about 95, Monday to Friday about 130

required_questions.question: What limits the window?
required_questions.expected_answer: pg_partman 5.1 goes in on 4 November after the freeze and needs runs on 5 and 6 November; the upgrade must finish before 12 November.

required_questions.question: What does the window cost?
required_questions.expected_answer: About 14 minutes of downtime, then about 38 minutes of slow reports.

required_questions.question: Is any item left after this one?
required_questions.expected_answer: No. The window is the last open item.

valid_alternatives.trade_off: The earliest possible slot and it leaves Sunday 8 November as a fallback, but it runs at about 95 writes per second instead of 40.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: The team wants a fallback date inside the weekend.

valid_alternatives.option: A weekday night between 9 and 11 November, 02:00 to 05:00 UTC
valid_alternatives.trade_off: Leaves a fallback before 12 November, but runs at about 130 writes per second instead of 40.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: Sunday 8 November is not possible, for example when the pg_partman runs fail.

closing_decision: One decision: the maintenance window for the major upgrade, for example approve Sunday 8 November 02:00 UTC.

understanding.problem: The major upgrade needs a maintenance window.
understanding.breaks: A window inside the freeze, before the two pg_partman 5.1 runs, or after 12 November breaks the freeze, the plan or AR-7.
understanding.cost: About 14 minutes of downtime and about 38 minutes of slow reports, in a weekend night slot. Naming the weekend shift as the cost also matches.
